journal_entries.description: Recognize finance lease ROU asset and lease liability at commencement
First annual payment, made in advance
Remeasure lease liability at the updated 5% rate for the reasonably certain purchase option
Third annual payment, made in advance after remeasurement
Accrue interest on the remeasured lease liability at 5%

notes: Purchase option is excluded at commencement (not reasonably certain), so initial PV is the 5-payment annuity due at 7%. At Jan 1 Year 3 the option becomes reasonably certain and the rate is updated to 5%, so the remeasured liability is the 3-payment annuity due of $80,000 at 5% plus the $30,000 option discounted 3 periods to Dec 31 Year 5; the whole adjustment goes to the ROU asset. Because exercise is reasonably certain, post-remeasurement amortization runs over the remaining economic life (6 - 2 = 4 years) rather than the lease term. The schedule retires the liability to exactly $30,000 at Dec 31 Year 5 with no plug.
